title: Mother & Girl Holding Newborn Baby in Backyard, 1960 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot taken in October 1960 capturing a warm family moment in a suburban backyard. A young girl sits in a folded aluminum webbed lawn chair, smiling lovingly down at a newborn baby wrapped in a blanket in her arms. Her mother, styled with a classic 1960s hair look and wearing a pearl necklace with a short-sleeved collared dress, leans in affectionately from above. The setting represents suburban family life in post-WWII America during the height of the mid-century baby boom.
